name: DTSL
english_name: Twin Dragons of the Tang Dynasty
english_description: Based on Huang Yi's wuxia novel of the same name and set in the turbulent jianghu of the early Tang dynasty. One of three independently developed games in this project (alongside dtsl2 and dtslmud) that share part of a base engine while each builds its own storyline. New characters begin at the Great Tang Academy, where a guided curriculum introduces the basics before players head down the mountain into the wider world.
